title: Unlinked failure ignores not-run: leaving test keeps refusing when a referenced case's latest executed observation failed and a later observation is only not-run (PR 43 review)
description: Unlinked failure ignores not-run: leaving test keeps refusing when a referenced case's latest executed observation failed and a later observation is only not-run (PR 43 review)
acceptance_criteria: With a referenced case failed at time 100 and only not-run at time 200, stage advance and stage skip at test are refused with refused:unlinked-failure naming the failed observation, and next and status name the same refusal
A later passed observation still lifts the refusal even when a not-run follows it; a case with only not-run observations does not refuse
The regression test fails before the fix and passes after it; fledge lanes run verify passes; hosted CI is reported only as observed

answers.constraints: specs/cli/context.md lessons: tasks.md checkboxes block change check, so cases and human gates stay out of tasks.md; keep the src/stage.rs diff minimal (PR 45 also edits it)
